name: telehealth-triage
idea: A clinical triage portal where patients schedule video consultations with licensed clinicians and an AI intake assistant summarises symptoms. Every symptom summary must require clinician sign-off before joining the chart, and consultations cannot be booked outside licensed state hours.
rules: Intake summaries flagged high-acuity shall page the on-call clinician within 2 minutes and block self-scheduled deferral.
